platforms.name: WREK Atlanta Official Music Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Atlanta, Georgia / Georgia Tech student radio
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee, account, login, CAPTCHA or mandatory payment is stated for the official music email or physical-mail routes.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WREK officially accepts music by email at music.director@wrek.org and also lists a postal delivery route. A human must select the relevant track and delivery method, verify ownership, release status, broadcast suitability, metadata and any clean-version requirements, approve all personal data and files or links, reconfirm the published instructions and perform the submission manually. The optional physical route must not be treated as authorization to automate package delivery.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-13 from WREK official first-party pages. The current WREK music page links directly to the official legacy How To Submit Music page. That page publishes music.director@wrek.org for music submissions and a Georgia Tech postal address, says common music media formats are accepted, notes that CDs and LPs may receive more operator attention and states that submission receipt is not acknowledged. WREK activity is current: the official site displays a live player, a 24/7 broadcast statement, electronic and world-focused programs, and playlist or station posts dated 2026-07-10, 2026-07-09 and 2026-07-07. The mailbox is a syntactically valid WREK-domain business address officially bound to music submissions. No email, package, track, attachment, link, metadata or personal data was sent, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.

platforms.name: KVRX 91.7 FM Official Music Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Austin, Texas / University of Texas student radio
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee, account, login, CAPTCHA or mandatory payment is stated for the official digital or physical music-submission routes.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KVRX officially accepts digital and physical music submissions at music@kvrx.org but explicitly rejects AI-assisted or AI-generated music. A human must verify that the selected MarcsMusic track contains no AI-assisted or AI-generated elements before considering this route. If that requirement is not met, the queue item must be closed as ineligible. For an eligible track, a human must verify rights, release status, format, metadata and broadcast suitability, approve all personal data and perform the submission manually.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-13 from KVRX official first-party pages. The official contact page publishes music@kvrx.org for all music submissions, states that both physical and digital submissions are currently accepted and separately lists operations@kvrx.org for questions. The same page explicitly states that AI-assisted or AI-generated music submissions will not be considered. The mailbox is a syntactically valid KVRX-domain business address officially bound to music submissions. Activity is current: the homepage presents a live signal and around-the-clock underground programming, the programming page lists Summer 2026 schedule blocks, and the official blog contains posts dated 2026-06-02, 2026-05-16 and 2026-05-04. No email, package, track, attachment, link, metadata or personal data was sent, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
